entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When we entered the room, Petr was..."
entries.dialogueText: When we entered the room, Petr was speaking to the cabinet members who were already seated around the table. As soon as they noticed me, they all stood up.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I gestured at their seats."
entries.dialogueText: I gestured at their seats.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""...And here's our president!""
entries.dialogueText: "...And here's our president!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr turned towards me. Everybody e..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr turned towards me. Everybody except him took their seats. He stood right next to my chair in the middle.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Good day everybody. Please have a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Good day everybody. Please have a seat."
entries.menuText: "Good day everybody. Please have a seat."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Ladies and gentlemen.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I looked around at my cabinet membe..."
entries.dialogueText: I looked around at my cabinet members. They were staring at me and waiting for me to speak.
entries.menuText: Say nothing and watch the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr stood right next to my seat in..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr stood right next to my seat in the middle. He turned to me and gave a wave of his hand.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""...And here's our president!""
entries.dialogueText: "...And here's our president!"

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He held out my chair for me to sit..."
entries.dialogueText: He held out my chair for me to sit down and smiled.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He held out my chair for me to sit..."
entries.dialogueText: He held out my chair for me to sit down and smiled.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Please.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When I sat down, everybody immediat..."
entries.dialogueText: When I sat down, everybody immediately took their seats.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I sat down."
entries.dialogueText: I sat down.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Ladies and gentlemen, we are here..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ladies and gentlemen, we are here to discuss our current status and plan the remaining of our term."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I know that some of you have had y..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know that some of you have had your concerns about our style of governance so far. There will be a time to speak up about these in the meeting today."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But I must also thank you all for..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I must also thank you all for your hard work so far. We are very lucky to have a team like this. All of you have been invaluable to this administration."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We have worked long and hard but w..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have worked long and hard but we couldn't reform the Sordish Constitution..."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia and Ciara grimaced at his remar..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia and Ciara grimaced at his remarks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas grimaced at his remarks."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas grimaced at his remarks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Ciara grimaced at his remarks."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara grimaced at his remarks.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Gus grimaced at his remarks."
entries.dialogueText: Gus grimaced at his remarks.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Having said that... Now we have re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Having said that... Now we have reached a critical point of our term. We are nearing the end."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We have successfully made changes..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have successfully made changes to the Sordish Constitution. This is a historic accomplishment. Without this team, it couldn't have been possible."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sadly and for reasons outside of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sadly and for reasons outside of our control, Sordland plunged into violent terror at the beginning of our term. It became our duty to save Sordland. We all knew it was an emergency."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Today, the state of emergency stil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Today, the state of emergency still continues. Despite making some of our jobs harder, it has also helped stabilize our nation."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Petr walked to his seat and spoke,..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr walked to his seat and spoke, still standing.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What's on our agenda?""
entries.dialogueText: "What's on our agenda?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We'll be discussing our current st..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll be discussing our current status and planning the remainder of our term."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr walked to his seat but didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr walked to his seat but didn't sit down. He took a look at the ministers.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Now that Mr. President is here, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that Mr. President is here, we can begin the meeting. I know that some of you have had your concerns about our style of governance so far. There will be a time to speak up about these in the meeting today."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sadly and for reasons outside of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sadly and for reasons outside of our control, Sordland had plunged into violent terror in the beginning of our term. It became our duty to save Sordland. We all knew it was an emergency."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As we all know, the state of emerg..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we all know, the state of emergency is no longer in place. In a plot against President Rayne, it was revoked prematurely by the Supreme Court."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Do not make a mistake. This plot a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not make a mistake. This plot affects all of us. An attack against President Rayne is an attack against our whole administration."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It is against the United Sordland..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is against the United Sordland Party. And ultimately, against the people of Sordland."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As we all know, the beginning of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we all know, the beginning of our term saw an extraordinary period of violence that led us to a state of emergency."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Mr. President was brave enough to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President was brave enough to act swiftly, and thus we have successfully restored stability in a time of uncertainty."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""As we all know, the state of emerg..."
entries.dialogueText: "As we all know, the state of emergency that was declared against the chaos in the beginning of our term, is no longer in place."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Mr. President was brave enough to..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. President was brave enough to act swiftly and revoked his decree when the situation was stabilized. However, the same Justices who agreed to the decree are now trying to use it against him."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Do not make a mistake. This is a c..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do not make a mistake. This is a clear plot that affects all of us. An attack against President Rayne is an attack against our whole administration."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabinet members started looking..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabinet members started looking around the room. Petr glanced at Nia and Ciara, who were sitting next to each other.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Even though some people, even with..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even though some people, even within our own administration, had hoped to see us fail in the Court... We did succeed."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Nia squinted at Petr and frowned. S..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia squinted at Petr and frowned. She then noticed me and immediately averted her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Petr held his eyes on the two women..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr held his eyes on the two women, an enigmatic smile on his face.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "The ministers looked concerned and..."
entries.dialogueText: The ministers looked concerned and kept watching Petr speak.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The Supreme Court blocked us once..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court blocked us once again. Unfortunately, some people within our team also worked towards this goal."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabinet members started looking..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabinet members started looking at each other and eventually set their eyes on Nia.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Nia squinted at Petr and frowned. S..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia squinted at Petr and frowned. She then noticed me and immediately averted her eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Petr stared at Nia and narrowed his..."
entries.dialogueText: Petr stared at Nia and narrowed his eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Ciara glanced sideways at Petr and..."
entries.dialogueText: Ciara glanced sideways at Petr and me, avoiding eye contact.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The new Constitution has brought u..."
entries.dialogueText: "The new Constitution has brought us one step closer to the Sordish dream. We should be proud for having strengthened our democracy."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia raised her hand."
entries.dialogueText: Nia raised her hand.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. Vice President. I wouldn't go..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President. I wouldn't go as far to claim that we have *strengthened our democracy*."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia raised her hand."
entries.dialogueText: Nia raised her hand.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. Vice President. With all due r..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President. With all due respect, I wouldn't go as far to claim that we have *strengthened* anything."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room fell silent for a few seco..."
entries.dialogueText: The room fell silent for a few seconds. Petr broke the silence with a cough.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You do not need to feel proud, Mrs..."
entries.dialogueText: "You do not need to feel proud, Mrs. Morgna. Please let me finish."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""We know where the real power is ga..."
entries.dialogueText: "We know where the real power is gathered."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the room turned to look..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the room turned to look at Nia. Ciara put her hand on Nia's shoulder.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But the past is past. We must now..."
entries.dialogueText: "But the past is past. We must now look towards our future."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The Supreme Court blocked us once..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Supreme Court blocked us once again. Another stain on our democracy."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The deep state has acted once more..."
entries.dialogueText: "The deep state has acted once more. Our proposal had gathered 166 votes, but was unlawfully rejected. The very parliament we control has stabbed us in the back."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We have reasons to believe that th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have reasons to believe that this was an organized effort which Mr. Soll himself was implicated in."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Our organization was flawed. Our p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our organization was flawed. Our party was not united. The very parliament we control has denied us the reforms."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The cabinet members started looking..."
entries.dialogueText: The cabinet members started looking at each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused and looked around the roo..."
entries.dialogueText: He paused and looked around the room.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We are investigating and analyzing..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are investigating and analyzing our faults. We will be taking measures accordingly."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced at both Lucian and me."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced at both Lucian and me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Our success with these changes has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our success with these changes has brought with it great support. Our party --which was divided at the beginning of our term-- is finally coming together once more."

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Nia did not respond. I kept listeni..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia did not respond. I kept listening.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll talk about that later, Mrs...."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk about that later, Mrs. Morgna. Please be respectful and let the Vice President speak."
entries.menuText: "We'll talk about that later, Mrs. Morgna. Please be respectful and let the Vice President speak."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I'm sorry, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sorry, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So... Where were we?""
entries.dialogueText: "So... Where were we?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Ah yes. Our success...""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah yes. Our success..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Our party still remains divided. I..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our party still remains divided. In order to look at the future, we may need to make some changes."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""On the other hand, the opposition..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, the opposition is exploiting our failure to reform. The latest polls show a steep increase in the opposition's support."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I must thank Mr. President for bei..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must thank Mr. President for being brave enough to act so swiftly. And thank you all for your understanding our predicament at this difficult time."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Iosef was nodding in agreement whil..."
entries.dialogueText: Iosef was nodding in agreement while Nia and Ciara whispered to each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia raised an eyebrow and stared at..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia raised an eyebrow and stared at Petr mockingly.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused and looked around the roo..."
entries.dialogueText: He paused and looked around the room.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He paused and looked around the roo..."
entries.dialogueText: He paused and looked around the room.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The emergency decree also gives th..."
entries.dialogueText: "The emergency decree also gives the president the power to enact laws that are otherwise not possible."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This will open the way for our lon..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will open the way for our long-awaited reforms."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He glanced at me."
entries.dialogueText: He glanced at me.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I nodded in agreement."
entries.dialogueText: I nodded in agreement.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "I shook my head in disagreement."
entries.dialogueText: I shook my head in disagreement.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We are all responsible for the act..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are all responsible for the actions of this administration. Today, we need to be united more than ever."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So... Let's start the meeting with..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... Let's start the meeting with a brief look at some reports."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He fumbled with the stack of papers..."
entries.dialogueText: He fumbled with the stack of papers in front of him.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We will do whatever it takes to co..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will do whatever it takes to come out of this stronger and serve our country better. If need be, we'll make major changes in our party structure."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lileas raised an eyebrow and stared..."
entries.dialogueText: Lileas raised an eyebrow and stared at Petr with crossed arms. Nia raised her hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Italic
entries.title: Player_Italic: "Nia did not respond. I kept listeni..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia did not respond. I kept listening.

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. Vice President. I warned you a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Vice President. I warned you about the path you took, but you did not listen."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The room fell silent for a few seco..."
entries.dialogueText: The room fell silent for a few seconds. Petr broke the silence with a cough.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So... Where were we?""
entries.dialogueText: "So... Where were we?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And how did you help us inside the..."
entries.dialogueText: "And how did you help us inside the Court, Mrs. Morgna? Please let me finish before we start arguing about the past."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Mr. Hawker is very adamant about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Hawker is very adamant about the impeachment, and Mr. President has given him a good reason."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Everyone in the room was looking at..."
entries.dialogueText: Everyone in the room was looking at Nia. Ciara, who sat next to her, put her hand on Nia's shoulder and slightly pulled her back.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mrs. Morgna. As a member of the Su..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mrs. Morgna. As a member of the Supreme Court yourself, you are supposed to have this case dismissed."
entries.menuText: "Mrs. Morgna. As a member of the Supreme Court yourself, you are supposed to have this case dismissed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll talk about that later, Mrs...."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll talk about that later, Mrs. Morgna. Please be respectful and let the Vice President speak."
entries.menuText: "We'll talk about that later, Mrs. Morgna. Please be respectful and let the Vice President speak."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""Understood, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Understood, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Nia Morgna
entries.title: Nia Morgna: ""I ca- Yes. I am doing my best, of..."
entries.dialogueText: "I ca- Yes. I am doing my best, of course."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You have our complete trust, Mrs...."
entries.dialogueText: "You have our complete trust, Mrs. Morgna."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr smiled at her."
entries.dialogueText: Petr smiled at her.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Maybe we should take a look at our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we should take a look at our current situation first."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""According to the latest polls, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the latest polls, we have seen an increase in our popularity. The public opinion is most positive."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Despite the recent troubles, we ha..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the recent troubles, we have seen an increase in our popularity in general. The public opinion is most positive."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Despite the recent troubles, peopl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite the recent troubles, people seem to be content about our administration. The public opinion has not changed much."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""With the latest developments, we h..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the latest developments, we have seen a decrease in our popularity. The public opinion has shrunk since we took office."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""According to the latest polls, we..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the latest polls, we have seen an enormous decrease in our popularity. The public opinion about our party is at an all-time low."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""With the latest developments, we h..."
entries.dialogueText: "With the latest developments, we have seen an enormous decrease in our popularity. The public opinion about our party is at an all-time low."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Citizens are most concerned about..."
entries.dialogueText: "Citizens are most concerned about the state of emergency."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Our historic constitutional change..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our historic constitutional changes did not reflect well on our citizens."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took out a piece of paper from t..."
entries.dialogueText: He took out a piece of paper from the stack and inspected it.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The biggest factor for the people'..."
entries.dialogueText: "The biggest factor for the people's contentment is the state of our economy. We have stopped the recession."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took out a piece of paper from t..."
entries.dialogueText: He took out a piece of paper from the stack and inspected it.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""One of the most important factors..."
entries.dialogueText: "One of the most important factors for the people's contentment is the state of our economy. We have greatly slowed down the recession."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The biggest concern of the people..."
entries.dialogueText: "The biggest concern of the people is the state of our economy. We are still plagued by the recession."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The biggest concern of the people..."
entries.dialogueText: "The biggest concern of the people is the state of our economy. We are slowly slipping into a depression."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""It is only a matter of time until..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is only a matter of time until the people will be hit further. This will have dire consequences for our administration."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Despite everything, the state of o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite everything, the state of our economy is in very good shape. We have stopped the recession."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Despite everything, we have manage..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite everything, we have managed to greatly slow down the recession."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""A major concern of the people is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "A major concern of the people is the state of our economy. We are still plagued by the recession."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This will have dire consequences f..."
entries.dialogueText: "This will have dire consequences for our administration."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""A major concern of the people is t..."
entries.dialogueText: "A major concern of the people is the state of our economy. We are slowly slipping into a depression."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If everything goes well, it is a m..."
entries.dialogueText: "If everything goes well, it is a matter of time that people will feel its results. Our economy is not looking too bad."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I must thank Mr. Holl for his grea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must thank Mr. Holl for his great work."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This is the time to give the best..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is the time to give the best we can. For this administration and for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Symon nodded with a dimpled smile."
entries.dialogueText: Symon nodded with a dimpled smile.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We mustn't lose hope and give it o..."
entries.dialogueText: "We mustn't lose hope and give it our best. Sordland needs us more than ever."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Petr turned to me."
entries.dialogueText: Petr turned to me.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'll give the word to the Presiden..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll give the word to the President now."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If everything goes well, it is a m..."
entries.dialogueText: "If everything goes well, it is a matter of time that people will feel its results. Our economy is looking good."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Our success with these changes has..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our success with these changes has brought with it great support. Our party --which was divided at the beginning of our term-- is finally coming together once more."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Gloria and the conservative wing o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Gloria and the conservative wing of the party didn't back us up."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Some party centrists have opposed..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some party centrists have opposed us due to our decision to veto the campaign finance bill."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Albin and the reformist wing didn'..."
entries.dialogueText: "Albin and the reformist wing didn't vote for us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Frens Ricter and the PFJP left us..."
entries.dialogueText: "Frens Ricter and the PFJP left us hanging on the assembly floor. They voted nay."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Kesaro Kibener and the National Fr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Kesaro Kibener and the National Front MP's didn't like the proposal and voted against it."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The Lotherberg group led a massive..."
entries.dialogueText: "The Lotherberg group led a massive lobbying effort against us in the Assembly which caused us to lose many votes."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Lucian and I have begun investigat..."
entries.dialogueText: "Lucian and I have begun investigating who let us down at the vote when we needed them the most."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Me and Lucian know the culprits.""
entries.dialogueText: "Me and Lucian know the culprits."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Isabel and the other justices leni..."
entries.dialogueText: "Isabel and the other justices lenient to her legal opinion did not support us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Heron and the other centrists vote..."
entries.dialogueText: "Heron and the other centrists voted against us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We lost most of our support after..."
entries.dialogueText: "We lost most of our support after editing the proposal to include changes to Articles 6 and 7."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Despite doing our best, we didn't..."
entries.dialogueText: "Despite doing our best, we didn't get enough support from the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The higher-ups of the USP has aban..."
entries.dialogueText: "The higher-ups of the USP has abandoned their support for our administration."
